cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Give It Up
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender something they value.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You called your medal priceless, so I've left the price blank. Will you give it to the charity sale?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Priceless means I wouldn't sell it. It's my only win.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, beyond an ordinary price. You could tell the buyers about the race; they'd bid for something special.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'd lend it for the display. I want it back.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A display first, certainly. Let me put your race photo beside it. They can see what you achieved before you hand it to the winning bidder.
